bobsweep - ultravision self-empty robot.name: bObsweep - UltraVision Self-Empty Robot Vacuum & Mop, 1.5-Gallon Capacity, 8000 Pa Suction, Object-aware Tech - Stainless Steel
bobsweep - ultravision self-empty robot.description: Built from real stainless steel, UltraVision’s dock stands at the top of the industry. While other docks require constant maintenance, UltraVision combines a massive 6L dust collector, powerful 1200W auto-emptying, and odor-filtering bags for high-performance results with minimal upkeep. An expert navigator, UltraVision delivers 8,000Pa of powerful suction and advanced Low-Height Object-Aware Technology (LOT) to detect smaller items like your favorite slippers—so nothing gets run over. Using LiDAR in conjunction with bObsweep’s proprietary Quantum Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (QSLAM) and real-time computing, it moves in precise, straight lines to cover every inch of your floors and capture every bit of debris. Attach the mop to vacuum and mop simultaneously for an added layer of shine. Make no mistake: UltraVision fully respects your privacy! UltraVision never sends images anywhere – servers, cloud, or otherwise – be it of your room layout or your cleaning habits. The extra large 6L dust collector compress packs up to 180 days of pet hair, dust, pet dander, litter, and kibble that furry family members leave behind. This sturdy bag is not your usual vacuum bag. It is made thicker and lined with activated charcoal for odor filtration and provides a better seal making UltraVision the ultimate choice for pet owners who love their pets, but not their mess.
